label: MiniMax H3 video with native audio

prompt_contract.style: prose description of one readable shot
notes: A named layer left unstated is filled by a surface default rather than left neutral.
Describe the action as continuous behaviour; a still description produces a static result.
The submitted text is bounded at two to seven thousand characters on this host.

The host rewrites the text before generation unless settings.promptExpansion is disabled; the default is balanced rewriting, and quality rewrites further at the cost of time. A submission whose text must reach the model as written states disabled.

camera_control.command_syntax: the vendor vocabulary is written in square brackets inside the prose, for example a bracketed push in; up to three commands share one bracket, comma separated, to run together; two brackets separated by an ordering word run in sequence
notes: The bracketed vocabulary is closed: a move named outside it is ordinary prose the surface may or may not honour, so plan shots against the list rather than against an arbitrary camera path.
At most three commands may be combined in one bracket; more fail.
A push or truck moves the camera body; a zoom changes the lens. The surface treats them as different commands, and asking for both at once produces neither cleanly.
Framing terms are prose, not bracketed commands; the bracket carries movement only.
One move per shot is the recommendation for a readable result, not the syntax limit; the bracket itself accepts three.

multi_shot_control.syntax: MM:SS.mmm-MM:SS.mmm followed by the shot description, ranges sequential and non-overlapping
notes: The two second floor above is a planning floor; visible degradation begins below about 1.5 seconds.
Each internal cut still declares its story function, as any clip with internal cuts does.

sweet_spots: 5s one moment, the shortest clip this host accepts

audio_control.sound_syntax: describe sound naturally in prose alongside the action
audio_control.dialogue_syntax: <d>[English] line </d> placed inline, one or two sentences per shot
audio_control.unspecified_behaviour: arbitrary ambient sound rather than silence
notes: Name the intended silence explicitly when a beat should be quiet.

frame_control.resolution_parameter: resolution preset, mutually exclusive with width and height
notes: The resolution preset alone does not set orientation; state width and height to fix it.
The resolution preset is accepted only when input media is supplied, so a text-only submission sets geometry through width and height.
Frame-image mode forbids explicit width and height.

input_modes.text_must_establish: world, character appearance, placement, state, camera, action, and landing
input_modes.limits: compositional variation is an expected risk
at most two, addressed as first and last
input_modes.text_must_establish: the physically plausible path between them, without creating a competing landing

input_modes.media_supplies: identity and appearance carried into new scenes
input_modes.text_must_establish: scene, placement, scale, blocking, contact, camera, and action

input_modes.limits: up to three, each 2 to 15 seconds
input_modes.text_must_establish: what remains from the source and what changes

input_modes.limits: up to three, each 2 to 15 seconds, and accepted only alongside image or video references
input_modes.text_must_establish: who speaks and how the audio relates to the visible action

anti_patterns: transition language such as dissolve or fade to black
requests for on-screen text, logos, or watermarks
slideshow phrasing that gives a shot no internal motion
contradictory style signals combined in one prompt
frame rate or frame count instructions
meta-instructions such as high quality or make it viral
a reverse angle whose lighting is the inverse of the shot it answers, which the surface tends to render with the light source in the background either way

A reference image that already shows the described pose in the described setting is reproduced as the frame, static composition included; the text and the other references do not override it. Choose the pose-bearing reference as deliberately as a first frame, and give a shot that must compose from text only identity references that show no such pose.

constraints.geometry: width and height together, from the listed pairs; the schema does not require them (2560x1440 by default), but without them the result is 16:9 whatever the references show, so state them in reference mode and text-only mode; refused in frame-image mode; the resolution preset needs input media and is exclusive with width and height
constraints.text: positivePrompt of 2 to 7000 characters, always required
constraints.prompt_rewriting: settings.promptExpansion is disabled, balanced (the default) or quality; the host rewrites the text unless disabled

frame_images.placement: at least one of them is not the last frame

constraints.seed: supported: an integer 0 to 4294967295; omitted, the service draws one

reference_videos.input: an uploaded media id or a URL, not a data URI

reference_audios.requires: reference images or reference videos in the same request
reference_audios.input: an uploaded media id or a URL

constraints.inputs_envelope: media keys sit inside an inputs object (inputs.referenceImages, inputs.frameImages, inputs.referenceVideos, inputs.referenceAudios)
